title: Argos portable profile configuration
description: Portable Argos configuration (schema version 1). Exported from and imported by the Profile > System > Configs actions. Contains saved API keys: treat the file as a secret and never commit it. Import merges by stable provider, tool, role and quota-group ID, replaces values explicitly supplied, and preserves unrelated settings, recon limits and local state. Ephemeral counters, cooldowns, queues, databases and host paths are never exported. Companion relationship: this document owns which settings are portable; provider rate-limit policy values are shared with the orchestration companion and re-validated on import.

schema_version.description: Portable configuration schema version. Argos rejects any other value.

exported_at.description: Informational RFC3339 export timestamp. Never required and never used to merge.

providers.description: Every configured model account, including local keyless routes.

tool_credentials.description: Primary and fallback credentials for each keyed OSINT tool provider. Keyless tools (Holehe) are never listed.

rate_limits.description: Quota group settings shared with the provider orchestration companion.

credential.description: Tagged credential reference. `inline` carries a saved key, `env` names an environment variable that must resolve at runtime, `none` marks a keyless route.

api_key.description: A saved API key. A blank string is rejected: it is not a masked placeholder.

name.description: Environment variable name. Import validation reports an unresolved name instead of importing an empty key.

kind.description: Provider kind. `subscription` marks an OAuth route that requires reauthorization on the importing machine; it never carries key material.

base_url.description: Endpoint base URL. https unless the kind is a documented local route.

quota_group_id.description: Must reference an entry in rate_limits when non-empty.

toolCredential.description: Only the provider id is required. A primary or fallback slot the document omits is not a supplied value, so it preserves the local account; an explicit null removes it.

provider.description: Keyed tool provider id: firecrawl, hunter, sociavault, newsapi, courtlistener, gnews, newsdata, currents, whoxy.

fallback.description: Explicit null means no fallback account is configured.

primary.description: Null preserves documented inheritance (Tool picker for decision roles, Recon for evidence curator and investigation controller, Classifier for entity resolver, Synthesis for summarization and claim assessment).

fallbacks.description: Ordered fallback routes. Order is priority; duplicates are rejected.

decision_fallback.description: Optional compatible fallback for decision roles; null means none configured.

quotaSetting.description: Import merges quota settings by (quota_group_id, scope). Groups absent from the document are preserved untouched.

scope.description: * for the whole account, otherwise a model id.

local_rpm.description: Argos's own override; wins over verified_rpm. An explicit 0 disables the quota.
